**Die Together** is a **Paper plugin** for Minecraft 1.20+ where all players share one fate:
if one player dies, everyone dies.

This plugin is perfect for hardcore mode, but it also works in normal survival.


### 🧶 How it works?

- Every time a player takes damage, it is displayed in chat.
  Scoreboard in right side of screen is showing
- A scoreboard on the right side shows the current HP of players.
- If one player dies, all players die together.
- Supports Hardcore and Survival game modes.

⚠️ In Hardcore mode, after death you should delete the world folder if you want to restart.

### 🌍 Supported languages

Chat messages can be translated into:

en English

ua Ukrainian

ru Russian

de German

### 🚀 Installation

- 1)Download the compiled .jar file.
- 2)Put it into your server's plugins folder.
- 3)Restart the server.

Or build it yourself from source.
